skills.trigger: When evaluating a fetal thoracic mass on ultrasound to determine the specific subtype of Congenital Cystic Adenomatoid Malformation (CCAM/CPAM).
steps: Assess the echotexture and cyst morphology of the lung lesion.
Identify if the mass contains single or multiple large cysts (>2 cm) with thin septations (indicative of Type I).
Identify if the mass consists of numerous small, uniform cysts (<2 cm) creating a 'honeycomb' appearance (indicative of Type II).
Identify if the mass appears as a solid, homogeneous, highly echogenic area without distinct macroscopic cysts (indicative of Type III/microcystic).
